title: The Earth Will Quake Until Nothing Remains
body:
There is no going back, no way. Allah, Allah. Allah, Allah.
••••• •••••••••• •••••••••• •••••• •••••••
Inna zalzilati’s-sa`atu shayyun `azheem. for the earthquake of the Hour (of Judgment) will be a thing
terrible! (Surat al-Hajj, 22:1)
This gives us the meaning that zalzalati’s-sa`ati, “the earthquake of the Last Day” will come before the start of
Judgment Day. Slowly, slowly it (the earth quaking) will increase until it reaches perfection and then the
whole world will be destroyed... and on Earth no trace will remain of mountains, human beings, animals,
plants, seas, oceans! It will all turn to dust with the manifestation of Judgment Day!
If you look to the west you will see the east, because there will be nothing to block your view and no stone will
remain. Everything will be destroyed and turned into dust! Allahu Akbar, Allahu Akbaru ‘l-Akbar. Laa ilaaha
illa-Llah! From the manifestation and glory of Judgment Day, yaa Lateef, yaa Lateef, yaa Lateef! amaan yaa
Rabbee, tawbah yaa Rabbee! Bismillahi ‘r-Rahmaani ‘r-Raheem. (du`a)
Fatihah.

Shaykh Adnan Effendi: All the planets, or only Earth?
It specifies only this world; the rest have their own creatures and they say without limit, “laa ilaaha illa-Llah
Muhammadun Rasoolullah.” They have Judgment Day and the Account of the Day of Reckoning, and Heaven
and Hell, as this is His Kingdom. Does only one world belong to the Creator? No, His Creation is limitless and
continuous, which means from Pre-Eternal up to Eternal! That is an Attribute of the Creator, Allah jala wa
`ala. From the Day of Pre-Eternity up to Day of Eternity it is ongoing: Creation appears and the fulk alMashoon, the Loaded Ship is filled with Creations. They have their own Judgment Day, their own Day of
Reckoning/Reward, and particularly Heaven and Hell for each of them.
Allahu Akbar wa lillahi ‘l-hamd! Allah Almighty is the Greatest and He is the Greatest Creator! From the day
of Pre-Eternity up to day of Eternity, He is the Greatest Creator and the Creation is continuous! Allahu
Akbar, Allahu Akbaru ‘l-Akbar. Lam yazal wala yazaal, “He is and will be as He always has been.” His
Attributes are lam yazal wala yazaal. His Creations are continuous, never stopping, from pre-Eternity up to
Eternity! Allah, Allah. O Shaykh! We don’t know anything, not even about ourselves. Who are you? There is
no answer. From where did you come? No answer. Where are you going? No answer. Two RijaalAllah met
at a place, greeted each other and asked, “From where did you come?” He said, “From there.” To where are
you going? “To there.” Allah, Allah. Where are you from? “From here.” From where you came? “From there.”
To where are you going? “To there.” It is continuous, from pre-Eternal up to Eternal! No one knows the
reality of `Azaal, pre-Eternity, or Abaad, Eternity. No one ever understood except one, Sayyidi ‘l-Awwaleen
wa ‘l-Akhireen (s)! He asked, “From which country did you come?” He said, “I came from here.” To where are
you going? “I am going here.”
O Shaykh Adnan Effendi! It is astonishing! We cannot understand the reality of an atom. Our capacity to
know cannot reach the reality of an atom: from where it came, to where it is going, what is its identity, what is
written on it? There is a stamp on each atom, revealing its Creator. All atoms are sealed and stamped,
according to whom they must return or to whom they belong. There is nothing in Creation that does not carry
this Seal/Stamp, the Name of its Creator! It is impossible to come in existence without that Seal of the
Creator and we cannot reach such realities, no! We cannot even come close to such realities. Allahu Akbar wa
lillahi ‘l-hamd!

O Lord! Pardon us, forgive us, have mercy on us, and accept our repentance. Hal min muddakirin, can
anyone remember or reflect? Hal min muddakirin, if the servant is not given (a mind), how he will know the
meaning of muddakir, “one who reflects.” Allahu Akbar wa lillahi ‘l-hamd! All the worlds can drown, all of
them can be put in an atom. When He says, “Put all the worlds in one atom,” the atom doesn’t become bigger
or smaller, no! The world with its original size can be placed in the atom, which remains in its actual size,
without the world becoming smaller or the atom becoming bigger! Subhaanahu wa Ta’ala!
Shaykh Adnan Effendi: Qadirun Muqtadir!
When Grandshaykh (q) taught me the meanings of the 99 Divine Names, he reached al-Muqtadir, “the
Absolute Powerful.” and he stopped, because you can say something about the rest of the Names, but can you
say something about al-Muqtadir? He is Muqtadir! What are the limits of His Absolute Power? There is no
way to give meaning about it! I wrote the Names al-Muqtadir, “Absolute Power,” Qadir al-Muqtadir, “The
Possessor of Power,” and Grandshaykh stopped. There is no way for anyone to understand the least level of
`Ismullahi ‘l-`Azeem , the Great Divine Name of Allah (swt), al-Iqtidar, al-Muqtadir! Tawbah, yaa Rabbee!
Fatihah.
